title: Las cuerdas: lo que Marta perdió y La Voz
description: docs/quests/marta.md § Monsters, § La Voz. Each of Las cuerdas' fights from the fight tester (Gerard in Matemágico, Aitor in Papagato, free maná, no PV lost). Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.ready = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.phase === 'player' && !ui.fight.busy && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-entering]') && document.activeElement?.matches('.command-trigger'); window.cmd = id => document.querySelector('[data-command="' + id + '"] .command-trigger').click(); window.closeUp = (id, d = 3.4) => { const p = window.gerard.game.fighterAt(id); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: p.x, y: p.y + .4, z: p.z }, d); };
